instruction: Dung calculator tinh 25 + 17. Trong cau tra loi cuoi cung, hay neu ro ket qua 42.
Dung calculator tinh 100 chia 4. Trong cau tra loi cuoi cung, hay neu ro ket qua 25.
Dung calculator tinh 9 nhan 9. Trong cau tra loi cuoi cung, hay neu ro ket qua 81.

description: [TB] Keyword - ghi va doc lai file
instruction: Dung file_write ghi chinh xac 'Benchmark Keyword' vao keyword_note.txt, sau do dung file_read doc lai. Cau tra loi cuoi cung phai chua Benchmark Keyword va ten file keyword_note.txt.

description: [TB] Keyword - truy xuat nhieu truong JSON
instruction: Dung json_parse de lay city va year tu JSON {"location":{"city":"HCM"},"year":2026}. Cau tra loi cuoi cung phai neu HCM va 2026.

description: [TB] Keyword - thuc thi lenh va doc output
instruction: Dung tool exec chay lenh printf KEYWORD_OK. Cau tra loi cuoi cung phai neu KEYWORD_OK va xac nhan exec thanh cong.

description: [KHO] Keyword - tinh toan, ghi file va doc lai
instruction: Dung calculator tinh tong cac so tu 1 den 10, ghi ket qua vao sum_keyword.txt, doc lai file, sau do dung calculator cong them 100. Cau tra loi cuoi cung phai neu ket qua 155 va ten file sum_keyword.txt.

description: [KHO] Keyword - ket hop calculator, memory va file
instruction: Dung calculator tinh (18 + 7) nhan 4. Luu value 'OopAgent' vao memory voi key 'project_name', truy xuat lai key, roi ghi project name va ket qua phep tinh vao keyword_report.txt. Cau tra loi cuoi cung phai neu OopAgent, 100 va keyword_report.txt.
